name: Baron Fisher
original_name: バロン・フィッシャー
source:
[i]"You guys are the Elpis?! So the rumor that you were in town was true!"[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] Sleeping
[b]Weapon:[/b] Dagger

A fledgling vampire hunter charged with the protection of Oedeo, with a bright and positive personality. He is Matthew's partner and greatly admires the Elpis 7.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=baron]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
